title: A Travis CI config is served (/.travis.yml)
summary: The CI config is downloadable, which names the build steps and environment the pipeline runs with.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("language:") and (body_contains("script:") or body_contains("install:")) and "html" not in header("content-type") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Keep CI config out of the web root.
